shape.text: An environment secret key begins with tr_, then one of the environment slugs dev, stg, prod or preview, then an underscore for a root key or _sk_ for an additional key. Those four slugs are the whole set Trigger.dev's own type allows.

The body is letters and digits only, exactly 24 characters for an additional key and for a current root key. A legacy root key, generated up to version 4.0.0, has exactly 20. The webapp generators and the published SDK pattern agree on these lengths.
Underscores appear only at the fixed positions of the prefix and never inside the body, and the key carries no checksum.
It is not established how a key behaves when glued to an identifier character on either side.

collisions.text: The public key has the shape pk_ plus the environment slug and an underscore, then 20 characters. The server classifies the pk_ prefix as public, so it is not a secret.
Short-lived delegated tokens (tr_uat_ followed by a JWT) and public access tokens (a bare JWT) are JWTs and stay with the JWT family.
Environment slugs outside the four, such as tr_test_ or tr_staging_, are not in the provider's allowed set and are not this key.
